extracted text: The 2519A aluminum alloy (Al–5.8Cu–0.2 Mg–0.3Mn–0.2Zr–0.06 V–0.05Ti–0.2Fe–0.1Si (wt%)) hot-rolled plate was provided by the Southwest Aluminum Company. The plate was solution treated at 533°C for 2 h, quenched and cold rolled 50% directly, and finally peak aged at 165°C for 4 h, which is designated as T8 temper, while the comparison group alloy has a process of pre-aging at room temperature for 24 h before cold rolling, which is T9 temper.
